featured_reviews.review_text: If you're looking for a great menu or healthy eating, this isn't the place. However, it more than compensates with great ambience. Especially the outdoor seating. featured_reviews.name: The Lone Crusader
featured_reviews.review_text: A cute little place to quell your hunger pangs for unwinding after a very interesting and brainstorming session at the Dr. Bhau Daji Lad Museum on Saturday afternoons. Located right at. the rear end of the museum, accessible from the entrance at the back of the huge sprawling mansion that houses the museum, it is not easy to locate, so do not forget to ask for directions. Air conditioned w, and equipped with a large LED screen which displays the museum interiors. Not many options available, but they do serve rather delectable vegetable sandwiches, microwaved if required. Two or three varieties of Maggi Noodles too are available, served piping hot, along with tea, coffee and a few cold drinks. The prices are surprisingly reasonable. Certainly worth visiting if one plans to spend the whole day at the museum and the adjoining zoo!!

featured_reviews.name: Betterwithbffs
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited this newly opened cafe @iteeha.coffee store in Mahalaxmi. This place has an amazing soothing ambience and I’m totally in love with it. Not only the ambience is comforting but the food is so good that you’ll be wanting more. We tried their Mac & Cheese which was exactly perfect for the quote don’t judge a book by its cover😂 It looked a little sad but honestly it’s one of the best mac & cheese I’ve ever tasted. The second was the Ham and Cheese sandwich, this is the dish that stuck in my mind. It’s super yummy and even after a few days of visit I’m still craving for more. The next was Butter croissant, it was flaky, crispy and loaded with butter. Chicken Quiche was our next choice. The pastry was perfectly golden and crispy and it’s definitely a good one. For beverages, we tried their House cold coffee with Vanilla bean ice cream, it’s definitely a must try for all those who love thick coffee shake. We even tried their Mocha which was also amazing. The staff even managed to convince us to try their new Orange Chilli Hot Chocolate which was something I was hesitant but honestly it was so good. The hot chocolate had the perfect orange zest and chilli spice. Everything was so well balanced. For the desserts we had their New York Cheesecake and it’s definitely one of the best I’ve had yet. In all it’s just a place you’d want to spend an evening at with relaxing ambience and good food. The staff was amazing making our meal perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit at this cafe totally has my heart. With great food and service this place is just a spot to relax. The vibe of this place is so peaceful and the ambience is just great. With a great subtle decor this place is absolutely gorgeous. Every corner of this cafe is Instagram worthy. We were served by Lloyd and Sashikant. They both were attentive and the service was quick. They even made sure every table and every part of the cafe is maintained clean.
Few items mentioned below are which I gave a try and would recommend it to all.
• Affogato Vanilla Coffee :- Basically it's an Italian dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream over which an espresso is poured. This combination is absolutely amazing and is enjoyed by every coffee lover. You either sip on it or have it with a spoon. The taste is strong and would definitely recommend it to everyone.
• Vietnamese Cold Brew :- This coffee is made using sweetened condensed milk instead of milk, sugar or any sweetner. This does taste very different and is something which you need to give it a try.
• Veg Quiche:- Quiche is basically a custard baked in a flaky pie crust shell. It's stuffed with various options and is enjoyed by every one. Here we tried is the veg quiche which had cheese and leek.
• Chicken Quiche :- Similar to the up one, only difference is it has chicken stuffing.
• Ham & Cheese Sandwich:- This one absolutely had my heart. Super super delicious crisp sandwich. The classic sandwich which never fails to amaze you.
• Classic Chicken Sandwich :- Great great filling absolutely different than we usually get and would anyday go for this one. Chicken lovers, this crisp amazing delicious Sandwich is worth a try.
• Chocolate Cake :- One of the best chocolate cakes I have had. Soft, melting in mouth this cake has my heart.

featured_reviews.name: PD
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Coffee Pilgrimage to The Craftery by Subko

The Hunt: Finding this place is a bit of a treasure hunt. Hidden deep within the industrial by-lanes of Byculla, the journey through the gritty, winding streets only adds to the payoff. It feels like a well-kept secret that you have to earn.
The Senses: The moment you step through the doors, the city noise vanishes. You are immediately woken up by a powerful, beautiful symphony of aromas—freshly roasted coffee beans, warm cookies, and artisanal breakfast goodies straight from the oven.
The Brew: This isn't just a cafe; it’s a full-blown coffee experience. Our group explored a variety of their manual and iced brews:
Ratnagiri Estate (Medium Roast): Exceptionally clean and balanced—easily the highlight for anyone who appreciates estate-specific Indian coffee.
Iced Long Blacks & Lattes: Perfectly pulled shots; the quality of the bean really shines through even when chilled.
The Atmosphere: It’s a nice, cosy space that feels both professional and inviting. Watching the "craft" happen while you sip your drink makes it feel special.
Verdict: If you’re a coffee purist or just looking for a breakfast spot that feels like an escape, make the trip. The "hunt" for the entrance is absolutely worth the reward inside.

featured_reviews.name: nisha b
featured_reviews.review_text: Lovely space, tempting menu but fails terribly in delivering what could be a lovely cafe. Limited roasts & bean variety, watered down pour over and tasteless coffees. We tried their espresso croissant that on paper sounded delicious but it barely had hints of coffee flavour & mascarpone was just nauseatingly sweet cream. Service - terrible. Slow, confused, servers without any knowledge of their own menu and with 7-8 people behind the counter for a café with barely 2-3 occupied tables, no one seemed remotely interested in doing anything useful. Our order was taken and forgotten within a matter of 10mins and the server came back to ask us our order again. Half of our order served and the other half again forgotten even after reminders, only to be delivered with an apology just before we decided to leave. No greeting, no basic etiquettes of customer service and no proper communication. For a cafe that positions itself as premium with prices matching, the standard of service and offerings definitely do not.

featured_reviews.name: Adil Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience & Space
Cafe Coffee Day is spacious and well laid out, making it a comfortable place to sit, relax, or catch up with friends. The large size of the café adds to the ease and openness of the overall experience.

Interior Condition (Scope for Improvement)
While the space is good, the café does need a bit of interior renovation. Some sections of the walls appeared decayed, and it was quite noticeable. A refresh would definitely enhance the overall look and bring the interiors up to date.

Coffee Experience
I had a cappuccino, and it tasted good—smooth, well-balanced, and enjoyable. It delivered the familiar Café Coffee Day quality that coffee lovers appreciate.

Merchandise Purchase
Along with the coffee, I also purchased a bottle from their merchandise collection. It was a nice addition and a good takeaway item for regular use.

Staff & Service
The staff was very helpful, polite, and attentive. Their friendly approach made the visit more pleasant and hassle-free.

Final Verdict
Overall, it was a good experience at Cafe Coffee Day. With some interior renovation and upkeep, this café can feel much fresher while continuing to offer good coffee, helpful staff, and a comfortable space.

🔶LION HEART,BYCULLA🔶

Finally i got a chance to visit this Outlet which is located in Byculla(E).I was so eagerly waiting for the moment to visit this outlet from a very long time.Heard alot of thing about this Restro Bar and wanted to give it a shot.The Outlet is Located just outside Byculla Station on the East side.There aren't any other outlet like Lion Heart in the area which make this outlet special.You come across alot of casual Family Dine In Restaurant in that same area,but Lion's Heart is one of its Kind in Bycula(East).The Restaurant is very easy to spot,but if you are having trouble locating the outlet i would suggest you to take the help of Google Maps which guide you to the exact location.

🔸Talking About The Outlet ➡️

Lion's Heart is one of its kind Restaurant located just outside Byculla Station on the East side.This outlet really lives upto its name and signifies the Lion standing out from rest of the usual Restaurants.Walking in the restaurant feels like you are really walking inside the Lions Heart because of its Premium Interiors and Huge Space.The Restaurant also has Fully Functional Bar along which some Comfortable Lounge and Table Seating.And also on the First floor they have Table seating for pack of 2-4 people along with Live Sports Screening.

Its really remarkable to Operate such a Good Restro-Bar in such a populated area.The Ambience of the restaurant is really Great and Vibrant.The Dim Lighting conditions and a huge screen used for Live Sports Screening which sticks the customers to there seats.The outlet has Indoor Seating which provide ample of comfort and for large grouos they also have Blue Coloured Lounge.

The Restaurant is usually packed on weekends and people come to Enjoy the Nightlife and Live Entertainment of rhis outlet.The food at Lion's Heart is really Taste and Mouth Watering.The outlet offers alot of varieties in North-Indian,Italian and Chinese Cuisines.The most commonly ordered dishes are Butter Chicken,Nachos, Cocktails, Mocktails,Brownie,Biryani,etc.

The staff working at the outlet is extremely professional and knows there work very-well.They are always there to help you and suggest you the best dish as per your taste.The restaurant also offers some board game to play and spend your time with your loved once.They also have a separate Smoking Area.

🔸 Speaking About The Food ➡️

🔰DRINKS/COCKTAILS/MOCKTAILS

◾1)Peach Flavoured Margarita-A chilling and resfreshing Mocktail which was required to beat the heat of Mumbai.The Mocktail had a perfect punch of peach along with some salt on its rim.

◾2)Lady in Red-A Mango base mocktail which i really liked.It was prepared from Mango Juice,Vanilla Icecream and Grenadine syrup at the bottom.The presentation was also upto the marks and pleased my taste buds.
Highly Recommended ❤️

Definitely you so give it a Try♥️

🔰MAIN COURSE

You must try it and give it a shot♥️

featured_reviews.name: The Munchy Tales
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lion Heart (All day dining) at Byculla is just a 10 mins walk from Byculla station, close to Veermata Jijabai Bhosale Udyan and Zoo.
Honestly? It is one of those hidden gems because the locality is not so good, the place is just worth visiting.

The vibe is so good it immediately puts you in a relaxing yet energetic mood. You just wanna let loose! They have a separate smoking area.

They have a large projector for screenings of sports. So you can enjoy live sports screening!
Our favourite was the DJ, special mention to him for playing such amazing tracks! (Not exaggerting at all). He plays right from all the hollywood songs to our desi tracks.
They also have a place specially for dancing. So in short, it's lounge worth visiting!

Coming to their food
In BEVERAGES, since they have a variety of Artisan cocktails and mocktails we didn't have to worry about what to order and what not to. You can also enjoy a beer in the bar and chill. They also have all the hard liquors.

We tried their
WHISKEY SUNRISE (COCKTAIL)
Whiskey, Red wine and home-made sour mix.
I honestly thought it would taste a bit sour and not pleasing at all. But I was so surprised when it turned out to be sweet. Not too sweet but really refreshing and smooth on the palate.

CHOCOTINI (MOCKTAIL)
Consisted of Ice cream, peanut butter, fresh cream and chocolate sauce. At the very sip the sweet taste of peanut butter hits you and it was so delightful to sip on this chocolatey goodness while having dinner.

In appetizers we had:

1) COTTAGE CHEESE MAMAROSSA
Fried paneer tossed in arabiatta sauce. What we didn't expect this particular appetizer to be so balanced. The creaminess of cheese and the sauce was so perfectly good that we finished it all in less than 5 mins. They present it so well! It came in a really unique plate (more of a cycle) (Refer pictures)

2) CHICKEN KEBAB SAMPLER
Four types of chicken kebab were presented with a hint of those smoked ends depicting their tandoori origin. The Chicken Tikka was tender and succulent whilst the Pahadi was a little bland but the other three kebabs made up for it. The Chicken Malai Tikka was our winner, really juicy and soft. It was served just like the Mamarossa, but in a train! (Refer pictures)

Mains:

LIFAFA VEG BIRYANI
This one in particular was one dish we found very interesting and thought of giving it a try since we don't think we will find a lifafa biryani anywhere.
The biryani is cooked inside an all purpose flour based dough (maida) which is folded in the form of an envelope and then baked. The biryani got an all together different texture because of this lifafa because it was super flaky which we loved!
It came with a side of Dal Makhni and Burani raita. After tasting the dal, we literally could feel the burst of flavours.
Overall, 5/5 for the biryani.
A must try!

The servers were so sweet and chatted with us and kept us entertained. They also helped us in deciding our orders!
Although they said the order might take 20-30 mins but served it within 10 mins of ordering!
Talk about quick service!

Thank you for such a wonderful #TeamLionHeart.

featured_reviews.name: NomNom Mumbaikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
So I went to this place called "Lion Heart" on Friday evening with my friends. Its a local bar with a modern touch given to it. Basically it’s a hidden gem in the vicinity of Byculla. We have tried most of the restaurants in this area and trust me Lion Heart is the one we keep coming back to. The ambience is quite nice. They have got sports screening and amazing music which will surely make you groove. This place is hardly few minutes away from station so travelling is not an issue. Wanna grab beer with friends post work ??? Then Lion Heart is the place for you.

So not only the place is awesome but the food here is also amazing. My job is to ramble through as much of a menu like this as I can, and I do put my back into it. But sometimes you need to step back from such an experience and work out what's best for you. So they do have an interesting menu. Recently they have introduced new cocktails and mocktails in their menu. Not only that they have started with buffet in the afternoon as they are all day dining lounge. I loved their lunch buffet because you can try a little bit of everything and its delicious. I have been craving their lunch buffet for awhile now so we plan on stopping in over the weekend. We were also pleasantly surprised with their dinner service. The food here is finger licking awesome and when I say that I mean it totally. The food here is pretty much spot on for authenticity. So we had Mai-Tai and Paparika Crush in cocktail and mocktail and in starters we had crispy chicken and Mumbai mirchi kebab. In main course we had ordered chicken manchurian sizzler. The service has always been very attentive whenever we have been here. And as for value, in my opinion it is well worth it and we have always left full and very satisfied. Wait wait we are not yet done! How can we complete our evening without desserts. For desserts also they have got an amazing menu. We had ordered chocolate sandwhich which was nicely decorated with gems. I really loved their presentation.

The staff was very polite, humble and helpful. Overall the place is just fantastic and must visit if in Byculla!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Barista Cafe Urmi Axis is the kind of place that does exactly what you need it to. Located in the same building as VFS, it’s an especially convenient stop for people waiting for their appointments. You’ll often find a steady flow of visitors coming in to pass the time, grab a quick drink, or settle their nerves before paperwork and interviews.
The cafe leans more toward practicality than ambiance, but that’s not necessarily a bad thing. It offers a comfortable enough space to sit, recharge, and take a break from the formal setting downstairs. The coffee is reliable, and the menu covers the basics well—nothing overly elaborate, but enough to keep you satisfied while you wait.
Service is generally quick, which fits the needs of its crowd. People aren’t usually there to linger for hours, and the staff seems to understand that rhythm.
Overall, Barista Cafe Urmi Axis works best as a functional, convenient pit stop. It may not be a destination cafe, but for anyone heading to VFS, it’s a handy and dependable place to spend some time.
